targets: Gentle shoulder mobility with the arm relaxed; pain-relieving distraction

summary.en: Leaning forward with the other hand on a table, let the relaxed arm swing gently like a pendulum.
summary.ru: Aage jhuk kar doosra haath table par rakhein aur dheela bazu pendulum ki tarah aahista jhulne dein.

indications: After shoulder surgery or injury when cleared
contraindications: Dizziness on leaning forward or low back pain in the bent position
Surgical restrictions on arm movement unless cleared

safety.en: Let the arm hang loose — the movement comes from your body, not from lifting the arm.
safety.ru: Bazu dheela latka rahe — harkat jism se aaye, bazu uthane se nahi.

setup.en: Stand beside a table, lean forward on your good arm, and let the other arm hang down.
setup.ru: Table ke paas khare hon, theek bazu par jhuk kar doosra bazu neeche latkne dein.

steps.en: Relax the shoulder completely and shift your body weight gently.
steps.ru: Kandha bilkul dheela karein aur jism ka wazan aahista hilayein.

steps.en: Let the arm swing forward and back in small movements.
steps.ru: Bazu ko chhoti harkat mein aage peeche jhulne dein.

steps.en: Then side to side, and in small circles.
steps.ru: Phir side ba side, aur chhote circles mein.

breathing.ru: Normal saans lein aur relax rahein.

mistakes.en: Using the shoulder muscles to swing the arm
mistakes.ru: Kandhe ke muscle se bazu hilana

progressions: Add a very light weight (when advised)

say.en: Let the arm swing forward like a pendulum.
say.ru: Bazu ko pendulum ki tarah aage jhulne dein.

name.ru: Chhari ke saath bazu uthana (madad se)

targets: Shoulder flexion range — assisted by the other arm

summary.en: Lying on your back, hold a stick with both hands and use the good arm to lift both arms overhead.
summary.ru: Peeth ke bal let kar dono haathon se chhari pakren aur theek bazu ki madad se dono bazu sar ke upar le jayein.

indications: After shoulder surgery or injury when cleared
contraindications: Surgical restrictions on elevation unless cleared
Sharp pinching pain at the top of the shoulder

safety.en: Let the good arm do the work and stop at a comfortable stretch.
safety.ru: Theek bazu ko kaam karne dein aur aaram dah stretch par ruk jayein.

setup.en: Lie on your back with knees bent. Hold the stick shoulder-width apart, resting on your thighs.
setup.ru: Peeth ke bal let jayein, ghutne mude hue. Chhari kandhon ki chorai par pakren, thighs par rakhi hui.

steps.en: Keep your elbows straight and lift the stick up towards the ceiling.
steps.ru: Kohniyan seedhi rakhein aur chhari ko chhat ki taraf uthayein.

steps.en: Continue overhead as far as is comfortable, using the good arm to help.
steps.ru: Jitna aaram se ho sar ke upar le jayein, theek bazu madad kare.

steps.en: Hold briefly, then lower with control.
steps.ru: Thori der hold karein, phir control se neeche layein.

breathing.en: Breathe out as the arms go overhead.
breathing.ru: Bazu upar jate waqt saans bahar.

mistakes.en: Arching the back to get further
mistakes.ru: Zyada door jane ke liye kamar arch karna

say.en: Lift both arms overhead — the good arm helps.
say.ru: Dono bazu sar ke upar le jayein — theek bazu madad kare.

name.ru: Wall angel (deewar par bazu upar neeche)

targets: Lower and middle trapezius, serratus anterior, rotator cuff; thoracic extension and overhead mobility

summary.en: Standing with your back against a wall, slide your arms up and down the wall like a snow angel.
summary.ru: Deewar se peeth laga kar khare hon aur bazu deewar par upar neeche sarkayein jaise snow angel.

contraindications: Pinching shoulder pain with the arms overhead
Neck pain or tingling in the arms with the position

safety.en: Keep your back and head touching the wall as far as is comfortable — do not arch.
safety.ru: Jahan tak aaram se ho peeth aur sar deewar se lage rahein — arch na karein.

setup.en: Stand with your back, head and buttocks against a wall, arms out to the sides with elbows bent 90° (goalposts).
setup.ru: Peeth, sar aur kulhe deewar se lagakar khare hon, bazu side mein kohniyan 90° par (goalpost).

steps.en: Keep the backs of your hands and elbows against the wall.
steps.ru: Haathon ki peeth aur kohniyan deewar se lagi rakhein.

steps.en: Slowly slide the arms up the wall into a Y shape.
steps.ru: Aahista bazu deewar par sarka kar Y shape mein upar le jayein.

steps.en: Slide them back down to the goalpost position.
steps.ru: Wapis goalpost position mein neeche layein.

breathing.en: Breathe in as the arms rise; out as they lower.
breathing.ru: Bazu upar jate waqt saans andar; neeche aate waqt bahar.

mistakes.en: Hands and elbows lifting off the wall
mistakes.ru: Haath aur kohniyan deewar se uth jana

progressions: Slower tempo with a hold overhead

say.en: Slide the arms up the wall — keep your back flat.
say.ru: Bazu deewar par upar sarkayein — peeth sapaat rakhein.

targets: Rotator cuff — infraspinatus and teres minor

summary.en: With the elbow bent and tucked to your side, rotate the forearm outwards against a resistance band.
summary.ru: Kohni 90° mura kar side se lagi rakhein aur forearm ko band ke khilaf bahar ki taraf ghumayein.

contraindications: Acute rotator cuff tear without clearance
Sharp pain in the shoulder during the movement

safety.en: Keep your elbow tucked to your side. Pain should stay within the level your physiotherapist advised.
safety.ru: Kohni side se lagi rakhein. Dard utna hi rahe jitna physiotherapist ne bataya hai.

equipment: Resistance band tied to a door handle at elbow height; small rolled towel

setup.en: Stand sideways to the band with the elbow at 90°, a rolled towel between elbow and side.
setup.ru: Band ke side mein khare hon, kohni 90° par, kohni aur jism ke beech chhota tauliya.

steps.en: Hold the band with the hand of the side being trained.
steps.ru: Jis side ko train karna hai us haath mein band pakren.

steps.en: Keeping the elbow in, slowly rotate the forearm outwards.
steps.ru: Kohni andar rakhte hue forearm ko aahista bahar ghumayein.

steps.en: Return slowly to the start — do not let the band snap back.
steps.ru: Aahista wapis aayein — band ko jhatke se wapis na aane dein.

breathing.en: Breathe out as you rotate out; in as you return.
breathing.ru: Bahar ghumate waqt saans bahar; wapis aate waqt andar.

mistakes.en: Elbow drifting away from the side
mistakes.ru: Kohni ka side se door ho jana

mistakes.en: Letting the band pull the arm back quickly
mistakes.ru: Band ko bazu jhatke se wapis kheinchne dena

dosage.frequency: Once a day or every second day

say.en: Rotate the forearm out — elbow stays tucked in.
say.ru: Forearm ko bahar ghumayein — kohni andar lagi rahe.

targets: Subscapularis, pectoralis major and latissimus dorsi (internal rotators)

summary.en: With the elbow bent and tucked to your side, rotate the forearm inwards across your tummy against a band.
summary.ru: Kohni 90° mura kar side se lagi rakhein aur forearm ko band ke khilaf pait ki taraf andar ghumayein.

indications: Balanced cuff training with external rotation
contraindications: Acute subscapularis tear without clearance
Anterior shoulder pain that increases with the movement

safety.en: Keep your elbow tucked in and move in a pain-free range.
safety.ru: Kohni andar rakhein aur bina dard ki range mein harkat karein.

equipment: Resistance band tied to a door handle at elbow height

setup.en: Stand with the band on the outer side of the trained arm, elbow bent 90° and tucked in.
setup.ru: Jis bazu ko train karna hai uski bahar wali side band rakhein, kohni 90° par aur andar lagi.

steps.en: Start with the forearm turned slightly outwards.
steps.ru: Forearm ko thora bahar ghuma kar shuru karein.

steps.en: Slowly rotate the forearm in across your tummy.
steps.ru: Aahista forearm ko pait ke samne andar ghumayein.

steps.en: Return slowly to the start.
steps.ru: Aahista wapis shuru par aayein.

breathing.en: Breathe out as you rotate in.

mistakes.en: Elbow lifting away from the side
mistakes.ru: Kohni ka side se uth jana

dosage.frequency: Once a day or every second day

say.en: Rotate the forearm in across your tummy.
say.ru: Forearm ko pait ke samne andar ghumayein.

targets: Infraspinatus and teres minor against gravity; posterior deltoid

summary.en: Lying on your side with the elbow bent against your ribs, lift the forearm up towards the ceiling and lower slowly.
summary.ru: Karwat letkar kohni pasliyon se laga kar mori rakhein aur forearm ko chhat ki taraf uthayein, phir aahista neeche layein.

contraindications: Acute cuff tear without clearance
Pain above the level advised by your physiotherapist

safety.en: Use a very light weight (or none). Keep the elbow resting on your side.
safety.ru: Bohat halka wazan (ya bilkul nahi) lein. Kohni side par tiki rahe.

equipment: Pillow; light dumbbell or small water bottle (optional)

setup.en: Lie on the opposite side with a rolled towel between the elbow and your ribs; elbow bent 90°, forearm across your tummy.
setup.ru: Doosri karwat letein, kohni aur pasliyon ke beech tauliya, kohni 90°, forearm pait ke upar.

steps.en: Keep the elbow against the towel and rotate the forearm up towards the ceiling.
steps.ru: Kohni tauliye se lagi rakhein aur forearm ko chhat ki taraf ghumayein.

steps.en: Pause at the top, then lower slowly over 3–4 seconds.
steps.ru: Upar thori der ruken, phir 3–4 second mein aahista neeche layein.

mistakes.ru: Kohni ka tauliye se uth jana
Jism ko peeche ki taraf ghuma dena

say.en: Lift the forearm up — keep the elbow on your side.
say.ru: Forearm ko upar uthayein — kohni side par rahe.

targets: Deltoid (middle fibres) and supraspinatus with gravity-assisted loading

summary.en: Lying on your side, raise the straight top arm towards the ceiling and lower it slowly.
summary.ru: Karwat letkar upar wala seedha bazu chhat ki taraf uthayein aur aahista neeche layein.

indications: Cuff rehabilitation when standing elevation is too hard
contraindications: Sharp shoulder pain on lifting
Surgical restrictions on elevation unless cleared

safety.en: Lift only as high as is comfortable — stop before shrugging.
safety.ru: Sirf utna uthayein jitna aaram se ho — kandha upar uthne se pehle ruk jayein.

setup.en: Lie on your side with the top arm resting along your body, thumb pointing up.
setup.ru: Karwat letein, upar wala bazu jism ke saath, angootha upar ki taraf.

steps.en: Keeping the elbow straight, lift the arm up towards the ceiling.
steps.ru: Kohni seedhi rakhte hue bazu chhat ki taraf uthayein.

steps.en: Go to about shoulder height or as comfortable.
steps.ru: Kandhe ki unchai tak ya jitna aaram se ho.

steps.en: Lower slowly.
steps.ru: Aahista neeche layein.

say.en: Lift the straight arm towards the ceiling.
say.ru: Seedha bazu chhat ki taraf uthayein.

targets: Supraspinatus, deltoid and scapular stabilisers in the plane of the scapula

summary.en: With the thumb up, raise the straight arm diagonally forwards-and-out to shoulder height and lower slowly.
summary.ru: Angootha upar rakh kar seedha bazu tircha (aage aur side ke darmiyan) kandhe ki unchai tak uthayein aur aahista neeche layein.

contraindications: Painful arc that does not settle with a smaller range
Acute cuff tear without clearance

safety.en: Stop at shoulder height. If you hike your shoulder up, use a lighter weight.
safety.ru: Kandhe ki unchai par ruk jayein. Kandha upar uthe to halka wazan lein.

setup.en: Stand tall with your arm by your side and your thumb pointing up.
setup.ru: Seedhe khare hon, bazu side mein, angootha upar ki taraf.

steps.en: Raise the arm about 30° in front of the side, thumb up.
steps.ru: Bazu ko side se lagbhag 30° aage ki taraf uthayein, angootha upar.

steps.en: Stop at shoulder height without shrugging.
steps.ru: Kandhe ke bazu tak ruk jayein, kandha upar na uthayein.

steps.en: Lower slowly over 3 seconds.
steps.ru: 3 second mein aahista neeche layein.

breathing.en: Breathe out as you lift; in as you lower.
breathing.ru: Uthate waqt saans bahar; neeche late waqt andar.

mistakes.en: Going above shoulder height with pain
mistakes.ru: Dard ke saath kandhe se upar jana

say.en: Raise the arm diagonally to shoulder height, thumb up.
say.ru: Bazu ko tircha kandhe ki unchai tak uthayein, angootha upar.

targets: Middle trapezius, rhomboids, latissimus dorsi and biceps; scapular retraction control

summary.en: Sitting tall, pull a resistance band towards your ribs, drawing the elbows back and squeezing the shoulder blades.
summary.ru: Seedhe baith kar band ko pasliyon ki taraf kheinchein, kohniyan peeche aur kandhon ki haddiyan milayein.

contraindications: Pain at the front of the shoulder when pulling back
Acute biceps or cuff tear without clearance

safety.en: Keep your shoulders down and your back upright — do not lean back to pull.
safety.ru: Kandhe neeche aur peeth seedhi rakhein — kheinchne ke liye peeche na jhukein.

equipment: Resistance band anchored at chest height in front of you; chair

setup.en: Sit tall facing the anchor with arms forward holding the band, elbows slightly bent.
setup.ru: Anchor ke samne seedhe baith jayein, bazu aage band pakre, kohniyan thori mudi hue.

steps.en: Pull your elbows straight back along your sides.
steps.ru: Kohniyan seedhi peeche side ke saath kheinchein.

steps.en: Squeeze the shoulder blades together and hold.
steps.ru: Kandhon ki haddiyan milayein aur hold karein.

steps.en: Return slowly, controlling the band.
steps.ru: Band ko control karte hue aahista wapis aayein.

breathing.en: Breathe out as you pull; in as you return.
breathing.ru: Kheinchte waqt saans bahar; wapis aate waqt andar.

say.en: Pull the elbows back and squeeze the shoulder blades.
say.ru: Kohniyan peeche kheinchein aur kandhon ki haddiyan milayein.

targets: Posterior shoulder capsule and posterior deltoid flexibility

summary.en: Bring one arm across your chest and use the other hand to draw it in gently.
summary.ru: Ek bazu seene ke samne se guzarein aur doosre haath se aahista apni taraf kheinchein.

contraindications: Pain at the front or top of the shoulder when the arm is across
Recent shoulder dislocation unless cleared

safety.en: Stretch gently. Keep the shoulder down — do not shrug.
safety.ru: Halka stretch karein. Kandha neeche rakhein — upar na uthayein.

setup.en: Stand tall. Lift the arm to be stretched to shoulder height.
setup.ru: Seedhe khare hon. Jis bazu ko stretch karna hai usse kandhe ki unchai tak uthayein.

steps.en: Bring that arm across your body, keeping it straight.
steps.ru: Us bazu ko jism ke samne se guzarein, seedha rakhte hue.

steps.en: Hold the upper arm with the other hand and draw it gently closer.
steps.ru: Doosre haath se bazu ke upar wale hisse ko pakar kar aahista qareeb kheinchein.

steps.en: Hold, then release slowly.
steps.ru: Hold karein, phir aahista chhor dein.

breathing.en: Breathe slowly; let the muscle relax as you breathe out.
breathing.ru: Aahista saans lein; saans bahar chhodte waqt muscle dheela karein.

mistakes.en: Pulling on the elbow joint instead of the upper arm
mistakes.ru: Bazu ke upar wale hisse ki jagah kohni ke jorr ko kheinchna

say.en: Draw the arm across and hold — feel the back of the shoulder stretch.
say.ru: Bazu ko samne se guzar kar hold karein — kandhe ke peeche stretch mehsoos hoga.
